name: Sparo Video Engine
description: Project analysis, Remotion Player preview hosting, Remotion Studio preview hosting, still generation, export orchestration, asset indexing, and diagnostics for Remotion Live.

capabilities.title: Sparo Video Engine
capabilities.description: Analyze Remotion project source, host the project's own Remotion Player and Studio preview runtimes, render stills/exports through the project toolchain, and report diagnostics.

actions.name: detectProject
actions.description: Detect whether the workspace contains a Remotion project and locate entry/composition source files.

actions.name: compileProject
actions.description: Compile a static native project manifest for Remotion Live.

actions.name: getCompositionManifest
actions.description: Read the current native composition manifest.

actions.name: evaluateFrame
actions.description: Evaluate a composition frame into Sparo's native preview layer model.

actions.name: renderPreviewFrame
actions.description: Render a scaled preview frame through the workspace's Remotion toolchain and return a cached image data URL.

actions.name: renderPreviewClip
actions.description: Render a short low-resolution preview video clip through the workspace's Remotion toolchain and return a cached MP4 data URL.

actions.name: ensurePlayerPreviewHost
actions.description: Build, start, or reuse the workspace's Remotion Player preview host for interactive playback.

actions.name: getPlayerPreviewHostStatus
actions.description: Read the current Remotion Player preview host status and recent logs.

actions.name: stopPlayerPreviewHost
actions.description: Stop the Remotion Player preview host for the workspace.

actions.name: ensurePreviewServer
actions.description: Start or reuse the workspace's Remotion Studio server for interactive preview.

actions.name: getPreviewServerStatus
actions.description: Read the current Remotion Studio preview server status and recent logs.

actions.name: stopPreviewServer
actions.description: Stop the Remotion Studio preview server for the workspace.

actions.name: renderStill
actions.description: Render the current frame through the workspace's Remotion toolchain to a local image still.

actions.name: startExport
actions.description: Render a video export through the workspace's Remotion toolchain.

actions.name: cancelExport
actions.description: Cancel or mark a native export run as cancelled.

actions.name: indexAssets
actions.description: Index project media, font, caption, and data assets.

actions.name: readDiagnostics
actions.description: Read project diagnostics and source control changes.

tools.name: SparoVideoEngine
tools.description: Analyze Remotion projects, host Remotion Player/Studio previews, and render stills/exports through the workspace Remotion toolchain.
